en.title: Events & Rewards Center
en.intro: Plan your next adventure with sourced schedules, reward conditions and a private checklist.

details.snapshots: First five different regular types each give a reward; completing five adds another. First Dazzling and Shadow photographs have separate rewards; either grants an extra reward once per phase. Special types do not count toward five. Repeats give nothing. Target Aniimo unknown.
details.dash: Solo all day; multiplayer 18:00–24:00, up to 8 Pathfinders. Redrock multiplayer special events unavailable.
details.reset: Pre-adjustment Whirlbite Basic / Prismana only. Refund/revert EXP, Star Up, Awakening and Capafruit. Verify eligibility in game.
details.homeland: Phase 2/3 schedule adjusted after update; furniture collection rewards. Exact times and quantities unknown.
details.season: Companion Handbook, achievements and Stamp Shop refreshed.
details.go: Racing; Avatar Frame and growth resources.
details.night: Daily Activity earns Halloween Candy for Candy House. Frame and Sparkling Crystal rewards.
details.fantasy: Jaguaraun quests; offering recipe after all tasks.
details.sim: Permanent feature; first-clear and weekly rewards.
details.nov12: Preview: permanent Affinity (rename, Heal/Swoleshroom effects; daily/weekly caps unspecified), Crescent Bay stories The Coral Sea of Dreams / Squarrel’s Poem of Revolution, Snapshots, Dash and reset. Paid Valiant Knight / Shadow Rose via Shop → Recommended, dates unknown. Mobile controls, iOS storage and camera improvements; combat/map fixes announced. Affinity comes from Party/Home, Star Up/Ascend, Pathfinder Challenges/Egg Heist, and wild/Alpha battles. The two stories are The Coral Sea of Dreams and Squarrel’s Poem of Revolution; coordinates and rewards unknown.
details.oct29: Season 1 Part 2 preview and historical schedule; not independent release confirmation.

en.compEligibility: Registered before the Season 2 version update
en.resetEligibility: Whirlbite Basic / Prismana obtained before adjustment

details.snapshots: 每阶段前5种不同普通类型各有奖励，集齐5种另有额外奖励。首次拍摄Dazzling及Shadow各有奖励，任一特殊类型可触发每阶段仅1次额外奖励。特殊类型不计入普通5种，重复无进度或奖励。目标伊莫未知。

details.egg: 18:00–24:00；3支参赛队伍，并非伊莫队伍容量。
details.sim: 常驻玩法，首通与每周奖励。

details.home: 赛季家具，阶段逐步开放。
details.nov12: 预告：常驻好感度（改名、Heal／Swoleshroom效果；每日每周上限未公布）、Crescent Bay两项新故事、拍照、竞速与重置。Valiant Knight／Shadow Rose分批在商店推荐购买，日期未知。另含移动操控、iOS存储、相机及战斗地图修复。 好感度通过同行队伍／家园、升星／进阶、开拓者挑战／夺蛋及野外／Alpha战斗获取。新故事为The Coral Sea of Dreams及Squarrel’s Poem of Revolution；坐标与奖励未知。

details.snapshots: 各段階で異なる通常5種類それぞれに報酬、5種類達成で追加報酬。Dazzling・Shadowは各初回報酬があり、いずれかの撮影で段階ごと1回の追加報酬。特殊タイプは通常5種類に含まれず、重複は進捗・報酬なし。対象アニモ不明。
details.dash: ソロは終日、マルチは18:00–24:00、最大8人。Redrockのマルチ特殊イベントは利用不可。
details.reset: 調整前に入手したWhirlbite基本／Prismana限定。経験値・Star Up・覚醒・Capafruitを返還・リセット。資格はゲーム内確認。
details.homeland: 更新後に第2・3段階の日程調整、家具収集報酬を追加。詳細時刻・数量は不明。
details.season: 手帳・実績・スタンプ交換内容を更新。
details.go: レースでフレームと育成素材。
details.night: 日々の活動でキャンディを集め、家を整える。フレームとSparkling Crystal報酬。
details.fantasy: Jaguaraunの全タスクで供物レシピ。
details.egg: 18:00–24:00、3チームで競争。アニモの編成枠数ではありません。
details.sim: 常設機能、初回・週間報酬。
details.interlink: 木曜04:00–月曜03:59、報酬は手動受取。
details.home: シーズン家具、各段階は順次開放。
details.nov12: 予告：常設の親密度（改名・Heal／Swoleshroom強化、日次・週次上限値は不明）、Crescent Bayの2つの物語、撮影・レース・リセット。Valiant Knight／Shadow RoseはショップのRecommendedで有料販売予定、日付不明。モバイル操作・iOS容量確認・カメラと戦闘・マップ修正も予告。 親密度はParty/Home、Star Up/Ascend、Pathfinder Challenges/Egg Heist、野生・Alphaとの戦闘で上昇。新物語はThe Coral Sea of DreamsとSquarrel’s Poem of Revolution。座標・報酬は不明。
details.oct29: S1 Part 2予告と過去の日程。独立した公開確認ではありません。
